Redragon M816-LIT Tri-Mode Wireless Gaming Mouse (10000 DPI)

Cut the cord and unlock absolute desktop freedom with the Redragon M816-LIT Tri-Mode Wireless Gaming Mouse. Available at Turbo Computer, this high-performance hardware component is expertly engineered for PC gamers who demand ultimate flexibility, precise tracking layouts, and ergonomic comfort during intense gaming sessions. It stands as the definitive choice for modern esports configurations and versatile desktop setups across Egypt looking for a multi-connectivity wireless hardware modification.

The Redragon M816-LIT features an advanced high-precision optical gaming sensor supporting adjustable sensitivity configurations up to 10000 DPI, ensuring perfect pixel acquisition. Built for ultimate versatility, it features Tri-Mode connectivity with high-speed 2.4GHz Wireless, stable Bluetooth, and a reliable wired USB-C option to ensure instantaneous tracking speeds. Complete with vibrant dynamic RGB backlighting, durable gaming switches, and a rechargeable battery structure, it guarantees top-tier stable daily hardware performance.
